items.content: When a sub-agent completion is announced to this session, ALWAYS reply NO_REPLY. Do NOT summarize or announce sub-agent results to Matthew via Signal. Instead, check sub-agent results during heartbeats or when relevant, and share findings naturally in conversation only when they matter. Matthew finds the auto-announce replies confusing because they reply to unrelated messages.
